jobs.title: Campus Security Officer — Full-Time Patrol & Emergency Response
jobs.description:
Houston Community College is seeking a Security Officer to patrol campus properties, enforce parking and safety regulations, and support the emergency response team. The role collaborates with police staff to address security needs across the district.

Requirements include a high school diploma or GED, a valid Texas driver's license, and prior security or related criminal justice experience preferred. Excellent communication and professional presentation are essential.
